actions.name: asset.inspect
actions.description: Inspect asset identity and exists_on_disk (package file existence; does not prove latest in-memory values were saved).

actions.name: blueprint.create
actions.description: Create a Blueprint asset; components are added using blueprint.edit.

actions.name: blueprint.edit
actions.description: Edit components or variables using the listed operation schemas; compile and save default to true.

actions.name: level.inspect
actions.description: Read current-level actors, including name, label, class, path, location, rotation and scale. Filters are top-level arguments.

actions.name: material.create
actions.description: Create a simple material with BaseColor, Metallic and Roughness; creation saves it.

actions.name: object.call
actions.description: Invoke only runtime-allowlisted functions discovered with object.describe_functions.

actions.name: object.inspect
actions.description: Read explicitly selected reflected editor properties.

actions.name: project.save
actions.description: Persist level/assets explicitly; do not add this to inspection tasks.

actions.name: system.describe_actions
actions.description: Discover action argument schemas and mutation flags.
